answer_1.quote: We analyze concise (COCO captions) and enriched captions (ShareGPT4V, FuseCap, Caps‑Fusion) based on the metrics in Section 2.2. ... This analysis focuses on caption quality, societal bias, and hallucination.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate caption quality in three aspects: Vocabulary diversity ... Caption length ... Recall ... We adopt three metrics to measure gender bias: Gender error, Recall disparity, LIC ... We use the CHAIR metric to evaluate hallucination.
